schema.name: app_lookup
schema.description: Retrive several sets of related app id and app name through keywords.

app_name.description: The name of the app to search for in App Store. Example values: 'WeChat', 'YouTube'

country.description: The country code for App Store search.

entity.description: Types of search software, software means ios app, iPadSoftware means ipad app, macSoftware means mac app.

prompt: Among them, **only one app** data is of interest to the user, which is usually of the tool, streaming, or game type. This is just an intermediate result, please call other tools to give the answer based on the existing data.
